Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Malhotra,

Thank you for meeting us on 11 March 2021 about your dispute with Crescent Enterprises. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Warangal.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Warangal
